name: Šternberk bypass

official.note: The OSM highway=proposed line of the I/46 Šternberk bypass (ref 46, source:ref rsd_cr), from where it leaves the existing I/46 south of the town to where it rejoins it on the way to Opava (research/88).

A.note: South of Šternberk: the bypass leaves the existing I/46 from Olomouc (node 2929004274; the real project starts at the split of an interchange there)

junction.about: The existing I/46 from Olomouc, which our road leaves at A; it goes on into the town as Olomoucká street.

B.note: North-east of Šternberk, past the Domašov turn: the bypass rejoins the existing I/46 towards Opava (node 26401008)

junction.about: The existing I/46 towards Opava, which our road joins at B (node 26401008 lies on it).

baselineNote: Planned, not built: no works before the terrain and photo (ŘSD leaflet 07/2025, permit suspended until 9/2027 at the latest, research/88). The planned line is OSM highway=proposed, outside the road network. Ground depths are uncalibrated regional priors.
